ActorTalk: You're not planning to "delete" everything here, are you?!
I will be careful. No alarms will sound.
As your supervisor, I can't let you damage F.O.S. property.
You're wasting time. What's your brilliant alternative?
I have system clearance. Let me try a proper purge.
...That could leave an audit trail. You're not concerned it'll lead back to you?
I'm more concerned about your data being recovered by someone else.
Helping an Ascendant like this... What's your angle?
My only objective is to keep you from causing any harm in F.O.S.
